symbols.reasoning: Opens queue, starts RAW document/page, allocates/copies payload and checks WritePrinter boolean and exact byte count. Frees unmanaged buffer and closes page/document/printer in finally. Discards returned spooler job ID and all EndPage/EndDoc/Close results, so finalization failure may report success. Partial write can already produce paper despite thrown failure.
